recommendations.feature: Home / Business switch in the header with two parallel nav trees
recommendations.rationale: Lets one site serve both audiences without burying B2B under 'Join Us'.
recommendations.benchmark: Lavazza US toggle; Faema Canada; Nespresso 'For Business'

recommendations.feature: 'Shop by your machine' selector + compatibility badge on every coffee and machine
recommendations.rationale: Guglielmo sells 36 mm capsules, 38 mm pods and 44 mm ESE pods; compatibility is the #1 buying question.
recommendations.benchmark: Caffè Borbone system menu; illy 'Suitable For'; Kimbo 'scegli le tue capsule'

recommendations.feature: Standard coffee PDP: one intensity scale (1-10), roast, tasting notes, Arabica/Robusta %, origin, best brew methods, cost per cup
recommendations.rationale: Today blends have 1-2 sentences and no intensity; this is the basic comparison data shoppers expect.
recommendations.benchmark: illy PDP; Lavazza PDP; Segafredo 'Character / Tasting Notes'

recommendations.feature: Faceted PLP filters (format, system, intensity, roast, decaf, pack size, home/office/bar)
recommendations.rationale: 87 SKUs across 3+ pod formats cannot be browsed without filters.
recommendations.benchmark: Lavazza 9-facet PLP; illy intensity buckets; Seattle Coffee Gear brew-method filter

recommendations.feature: Subscribe & Save on PDP with self-serve frequency, skip, pause, cancel
recommendations.rationale: Capsules and beans are repeat purchases; there is no subscription today.
recommendations.benchmark: illy 20% + free shipping; Lavazza My Way 25%; Wake Up Kaffee-Abo

recommendations.feature: Transparent volume pricing table on PDP (6/12/18 units, case packs)
recommendations.rationale: Turns the hidden 5-8% plugin discount into a visible reason to buy more.
recommendations.benchmark: Borbone 'more you buy, more you save'; illy Coffee Case Packs; Wake Up 5+1 kg

recommendations.feature: Reviews with photos, star ratings in listings and review schema
recommendations.rationale: Zero reviews today; social proof is standard on every benchmark.
recommendations.benchmark: Segafredo Judge.me + AggregateRating; Partners 6,100+ reviews

recommendations.feature: Catalog hygiene: remove 'Order Adjustment', back-in-stock alerts, 'Request a quote' instead of $0
recommendations.rationale: About 40 of 87 SKUs are out of stock and several machines show $0.
recommendations.benchmark: Lavazza / illy 'Notify me'; Chris' Coffee and Faema commercial quote flows

recommendations.feature: B2B solution finder (venue, cups/day, needs, contact) replacing the long inquiry form
recommendations.rationale: Short qualifying steps convert better and route leads to the right rep.
recommendations.benchmark: Lavazza Professional UK 4-step finder; Chris' Coffee commercial questionnaire

recommendations.feature: 'Book a tasting / consultation' CTA on every business page
recommendations.rationale: An importer's strongest B2B hook is tasting the coffee on the client's own machine.
recommendations.benchmark: Vergnano 'Request a consultation'; Seattle Coffee Gear free consultation; Stumptown personalized consultation

recommendations.feature: Service request form with triage (partner / business / home), machine, serial, photos
